summary: American Healthcare REIT filed a prospectus supplement for a forward-sale offering of 14 million shares of common stock. The forward purchaser (Bank of America) will borrow and sell shares to the underwriter at $50.005 per share; the issuer will receive proceeds only upon physical settlement within ~24 months. The filing does not announce a major corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is a routine capital markets transaction—an at-the-market or forward equity offering—not a special situation triggering a change-of-control or strategic shift. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. Watch the pace of settlement; risk-arb angle is negligible.
